documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management reported strong revenue and profit growth for the quarter and full year, driven by the shift toward in-house manufacturing and stable demand. The company outlined priorities including scaling manufacturing capacity utilization, increasing the manufacturing revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries, and managing input cost volatility through proactive inventory strategies. Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited held its Q3 and 9M FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of commercial production at its new manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Management reported financial growth for the quarter, with revenue increasing by 5.38% year-on-year to INR 33.54 crores and EBITDA surging significantly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

guidance.claim: The company expects overall EBITDA margins to increase by 2% to 3% as manufacturing scales up.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: The company aims to shift its revenue mix so that manufacturing and trading each contribute 50%.
guidance.quote: Right now, . Like it is in trading and manufacturing right now what we did as of now was 75%-25% that will become 50%-50% .

guidance.claim: Trading revenue growth is expected to be stable around 10% to 20% for the year.
guidance.quote: 10%-20% growth, but the focus will continue to be on manufacturing for this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects full capacity utilization of the manufacturing plant by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: The company expects manufacturing margins to reach near about 50% in the coming time according to production.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: Management expects trading and manufacturing revenues to become equal within 1 and 2 years.
guidance.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is receiving a very good response in the domestic market for wood-coating products.
demand_outlook.quote: So, that is why we are looking for wood-coating products to grow very rapidly.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance, prompt technical services, and regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing amid challenges faced by Bangladesh.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery funded through internal resources over the next couple of months.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company can expand manufacturing capacity by adding vessels costing around INR3 crores to INR5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commenced commercial production at its first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The current facility allows for product flexibility and capacity expansion without further incremental capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The expected payback period for the INR 40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is between 4 to 5 years.
capex_expansion.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration through in-house manufacturing is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: Proactive inventory strategy helped secure raw materials at favorable blended costs to provide near-term margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 revenue was INR 33.54 crores, growing by 5.38% year-on-year, while EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR 7.11 crores.
margins_costs.quote: In quarter 3 financial year '26, the company reported a revenue of INR33.54 crores, growing by 5.38% year-on-year. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, revenue recorded a sharp 78.54% increase compared to the quarter 2 of the financial year '26. The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax rose by 117.4% to INR 4.06 crores with the PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax also showed strong growth, rising by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that basic raw material prices at the plant have not seen any significant changes in the last 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the new manufacturing facility is 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company utilized around 60% capacity in the first two months of manufacturing.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of INR 33 crores revenue in Q3, 25% came from manufacturing and 75% from the trading business.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, out of this INR33 crores revenue in Q3, from the manufacturing we are getting 25% and rest of the 75% from the trading business.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital requirements are expected to be managed through internal availability and strong cash flows without becoming a constraint.
capital_allocation.quote: So, Nidhi ji, basically we aren't expecting that working capital as such should become any constraint in our growth, mostly because internal availability is there, and more than that our cash flow is very good.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing capex, INR 30 crores is a bank loan and INR 20 crores was funded through IPO for land purchase and internal accruals/promoter loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: The short-term borrowings carry an interest rate of 8.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: The conference call disclaimer notes that forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainty and actual results may differ.
risks_headwinds.quote: The statements are not guarantees of future performance and involve risks and uncertainty.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch new products resulting from R&D trials within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: The focus for the company includes reducing debt utilizing cash generated from internal accruals.
management_commitments.quote: So right now, the maximum requirement of our capex we have done, you know the manufacturing unit is already working. So now focus is on reducing debt also for our company.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by an advanced and sustainable textile coating facility by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to achieve full capacity utilization by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects trading and manufacturing to reach an equal 50-50 split within 1 and 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The term loan moratorium period ends in June 2026.
The company has planned an expansion within the next 6 months based on discussions for domestic binders and potential inks.
management_commitments.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
